prebirth.note: No Plate-birth marker; first birth is exactly the exclusive endpoint.

firstBirth.note: P1 birth marker is at audio offset zero.

detailPreset.padding: zero-pad both channels at the end to exactly 10 seconds; trim longer input

zoom.note: Exactly 10 decoded-audio seconds, selected from simulation milestones; actual simulation span and contact timing are mapped through clock anchors. No normalization or padding.

overviewZoomPreset.spectrogramAggregation: maximum fixed-dBFS frame value per overview pixel column and frequency row
overviewZoomPreset.contactScale: 2400 individual FOOT_CONTACT contacts per 10-second bucket fills the fixed 28-pixel strip
overviewZoomPreset.grayscale: fixed linear mapping from -100..0 dBFS; gamma 1; no content normalization

renderer.normalization: none; fixed full-scale waveform and fixed dBFS spectrogram
renderer.clockMap: Each PCM window is one scheduled 10 s render at 48 kHz. Absolute anchors map the recorded simulation endpoints to PCM sample 0 and sampleCount; display-only anchors/events are shifted by the window start because the existing overview API requires zero-relative time.
renderer.legacyScheduler: The legacy Plate handles strikes on its audio render quantum: actual dispatch is 0–127 samples after the requested sample frame. Receipts are matched by requested sample frame because source events may be emitted out of chronological order; requested and actual frames are not interchangeable.
renderer.bornPlateScheduler: Born Plate strike messages use their scheduled sample frame exactly. Their routed-message list is stored separately from FOOT_CONTACT groups; the counts and events are not assumed to be one-to-one.
